origins.name: Alacrity

perks.description: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

enhanced.name: Slickdraw
enhanced.description: Significantly increases handling, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

enhanced.name: Enlightened Action
enhanced.description: Dealing damage significantly improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Explosive Light
enhanced.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Cascade Point
enhanced.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Full Court
perks.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.

enhanced.name: Full Court
enhanced.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.
